description: Which posted patches carry a line: the +/- lines of every patch posted to the lists, for an identifier, line or hunk. One entry per series (thread): first_version and latest_version carrying it (message_id, date, from, version, patch files with urls, matching lines), message count, and commit (the one that landed it via its Discussion: link, or null). Words match from a word start; any whitespace run matches; several lines must be in one file. complete=false (cut says why) at the read cap or budget.

query.description: Identifier, line or hunk (max 32 lines); a leading + or - names the side

name: search_patch_lines
